brief: launch ad for our new running shoe, 30 seconds, YouTube

context.audience: amateur runners 25-45 who run before work

concept: Every morning run starts as a negotiation with the alarm; the shoe is the reason you win it.
plan_outline: 1. CU · top · static · dark bedroom, phone glow · a phone alarm lights up at 5:30, a hand hovers over snooze (3 s, the hook; screen blank and glowing, no readable UI)
2. MS · eye · static · same bedroom · a woman in her thirties sits up, looks at the shoes by the door (3 s)
3. ECU · low · push in · hallway floor · laces pulled tight on the new shoe, the sole's texture (2 s)
4. WS · eye · track · empty city street at blue hour · she runs, the street lamps still on (5 s)
5. CU · low · track · same street · the shoe striking wet tarmac in slow motion, spray lit by a lamp (3 s)
6. MCU · eye · handheld · riverside at sunrise · she slows, breathing, smiling at the light (4 s)
7. WS · high · crane · riverside at sunrise · she runs on, small against the river and the rising sun (5 s)
8. Hero · eye · orbit · dark ground, rim light · the shoe alone (3 s)
9. End card (page) · logo, 'Win the morning.' (2 s)
why: The first 5 s carry the brand promise before 'Skip': the alarm is a universal hook and the shoes are seen at once.
Size and light progress with the story: dark interior close-ups → blue-hour wides → golden sunrise; the grade is the arc.
One runner throughout, described the same way in every shot (a character reference kept first).
The product's hero moment is a slow-motion strike: the model handles one clear motion well; no complex footwork.
